items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well, at the Happy Landing, when I first went to the Happy Landing it was Israel band... So we all quit.

ctx.x: Would he ever use the saxophone Buddy?
Oh at times, yeah. He used the saxophone, used Israel Garman playing saxophone. You see, at that time Israel used to use the saxophone in clarinets.
Was saxophone going over big then or what did it do?
